newsitem.title: USA: CSW unit files for rate rehearing.
newsitem.headline: CSW unit files for rate rehearing.

text.p: Central and South West Corp said its Central Power and Light Co unit had filed a motion for rehearing regarding a final order issued March 31 by the Public Utility Commission of Texas in a rate case.
The commissioners ordered CPL to reduce its retail rates by about $27 million from the level existing before CPL put higher bonded rates into effect last May, the company said.
The commissioners also voted to require CPL to lower its rates by about $16 million in 1998, and by an additional $16 million in 1999, it said.
CPL in November 1995 filed a request to increase its retail base rates by about $71 million. The proposed rate increase was put into effect under bond last May.
The motion for rehearing asks the Public Utility Commission to reconsider several issues in the rate case, the company said.
